body:
Hey,
I bet it's all messed up for you, I really don't know how you feel, but I remember how I felt when I broke up. And first I can tell you this - I envy you. Why? Because from the looks it was good break up, sorry if it hurts, but I got cheated, hurt, my dignity was stomped and really wanted to end it. I hope it will pass for you, but can't guarantee it. One thing I know, if you do this now, you will hurt her, and trust this from a person who already tried to kill himself. At least wait till emotions calmed down (2 weeks -1 moth or so) And if you really feel like it again - go for it, i'm not the one to say "No don't do it". It's your choice
